text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm Mejiro Dober.
Nice to meet you from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to become a strong Umamusume.
A strong Umamusume who can run with confidence,
no matter what—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You know, I want to become a strong Umamusume.
A strong Umamusume who can run with confidence,
no matter what happens—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...So that's the deal.
I'll be... in your care from now on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why, Trainer.
Train me thoroughly, okay?
I'll do my best... to live up to your expectations.

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
